frozen_evaluation.method: 10,000 complete-game bootstrap draws within each cell, paired across policies and noise versions. Equal weight per cell. One A training seed; no between-seed CI. Per-cell secondary p-values are unadjusted and all are reported.

transfer_identifier_audit.interpretation: Diagnostic only: condition on grammar-valid questions to separate identifier errors from split quality. Primary EIG still includes every counted question and INVALID retains zero EIG. No output was repaired or rescored.

training_audit.parser_exploit_assessment: Every accepted predicate is replayed through the fixed safe AST parser and exact table evaluation. Invalid/malicious strings never execute code. No broader adversarial security guarantee is inferred.

per_update_interpretation: Training outcomes are on the policy before each update. Eight games share one hidden target and table. Curriculum changes at updates 3,5,16,23,27; fixed development cases, not raw training slopes alone, assess learning.
uncertainty: This summary covers A23 only. A11 versus A23 comparisons and the separate suffix/hard-mode data are in replication_summary.json. Development uses eight fixed cases; frozen cells use 28 paired games. B41 has not run.

sample_train_logprob_diagnostic.interpretation: Native token sequences match exactly; training and sampling log probabilities are not bit-identical. The backend cause is not established. The standard importance-sampling loss uses the recorded rollout log probabilities; no correction or experiment setting changed.
